fields.title: Embroidery Text
fields.description:
IMPORTANT:   

  *Text will be embroidered exactly as typed by the customer* 
Please make sure to proof read prior to check out.  

   

  • Basic, Gothic, Script & Tempo  fonts are   all lowercase.   

  • College, Roman & Modern  fonts are   all uppercase.

fields.title: Twill Patch Text / Greek Letters - Line 1
fields.description: Twill Patch Font is 'Varsity' by default

fields.title: Background Color - Line 1
fields.description:
(*optional) 

   Foreground vs Background Color   

   

 Disclaimer: If you would like your Twill Patch to be a 1 Color Layer only, please select the NONE option below for the background color. 

   

 Otherwise, if you choose the same background color as the foreground color, they will blend together and become hard to read.
